lines.text: Ghost Trials finds the failure before the world does.
Give it an executable controller and a task. It searches bounded physical conditions.
A stored outcome is not proof of execution.
CPU evidence is simulation evidence, not a hardware attestation.
Ghost Trials breaks the trial first.
A hazard becomes a scenario, a simulation, and a judged trial.
The hunt varies friction, mass, and timing, inside a budget of three to fifty trials.
A Ghost Case is saved only after the artifact and metric checks pass.
Nine bounded grid trials, then the same case replays on another controller.
Fixed on a case means this candidate passed this case.
Avoided weighs one. Mitigated weighs zero point six five. Failed weighs zero point two. Catastrophic weighs zero.
The default path runs real headless MuJoCo on CPU. No GPU is required.
The GPU path has not been demonstrated end to end.
An unavailable score is null, not zero.
Insufficient evidence is excluded, and shown separately.
It is not a safety certification service.
